items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Raymond Lopez and I went to see her. Raymond did the talking.

ctx.x: Uh, he was a big-time actor. Uh, he was a big-time actor.

Uh, he was a big-time actor. Uh, he was a big-time actor. Uh, he was a big-time actor. Uh, he was a big-time actor. He, we were sold. So, he made an appointment. And instead of Tommy Brown going to see Myrtle Howard, who was staying at the Old Groomall Hotel, Raymond Lopez and I went to see her. Raymond did the talking. And we were, uh, ordered the job right away. In the meantime, Joe Gorham had got in touch with Smiley Carbett and told him where to find the air. And so, Carbett says, All right. And said, send…
Was that called the Panama Limited then, still? No.
